svg.title: How scene adaptation balances response and stability
svg.desc: Measure the brightness of the current pictures. Stabilize the estimate across nearby frames, while responding to scene changes. Use the resulting estimate to adapt the tone mapping. This is a conceptual sequence, not a particular implementation.

g.text: How bright is the scene now?
Smooth small changes within a scene
React more quickly when the scene changes
Use a response suited to the current scene
Conceptual flow · implementations may combine these steps
